when.q: When will I get my ticket?
when.a: Your e-ticket arrives by email as soon as payment is confirmed. It usually takes a few minutes.

cancel.a: You can cancel for free within 24 hours of booking. After that, the airline's rules apply. [İPTAL KOŞULLARI]

bags.q: Is baggage included in the price?
bags.a: We show what's included on every result card. You can add extra baggage with one tap while booking.

transfer.q: Do I need to check in my bags again on a connecting flight?
transfer.a: Usually not for connections on the same ticket. Routes combining different airlines may require it; we clearly mention this on the flight card.

payment.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: Credit and debit cards, iDEAL, Apple Pay and Google Pay.
